value.rationale: The fixed positive-rate matching of only n bridges competes with n(n−1) internal edges, yet creates a nondegenerate Poisson(lambda) number of irreversible intercommunity dimers and parity-dependent order-one probability of two permanently uncovered sites; this is a natural structural finite-size jamming statistic rather than an arbitrary subcase or a new label for a known table. The Lyapunov tail bound addresses the nontrivial interchange of large-system and infinite-time limits.
